description.zh: 是否全部删除，只针对TagKey.N为空时有效。 取值范围： true  false True False  默认是 false
description.en: Specifies whether to delete all tags. This parameter is valid only when TagKey.N is empty. Valid values: true, false, True, and False. Default value: false.
The resource IDs. A maximum of 50 subkeys are supported.
The resource type. Set this parameter to PolarDBXInstance.
The tag keys. A maximum of 20 subkeys are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type PolarDBXInstance --all false --resource-id pxc-xxxxx --tag-key 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardbx UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'pxc-xxxxx' --TagKey.1 1 --ResourceType PolarDBXInstance --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
